title: Reconstruct a named Tacuinum correction network jointly with qualities and suitability
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: a fixed external medical passage supplies reciprocal remedy links, unequal qualities, common suitability arguments and different harms. Reconstruct those linked contents with one global vocabulary instead of choosing separate fluent meanings for each Voynich record.

design.external_primary: MediManus diplomatic transcription of BnF Latin 9333, https://medimanus.chs.harvard.edu/app/en/pharmantica/tacuinum_sanitatis . Exact initial passage: external manuscript 026r Lactuce, 026v Herba pireti, 027r Apium. These are external addresses, not Voynich selectors. GDT813 had already cited this transcription for Aqua aluminosa; the source itself is not claimed newly discovered.
design.source_binding: Lactuce names apium and feniculum as correctives; Apium names lactucae as its corrective; Herba pireti also names apium. Lactuce is cold/moist II; Apium is hot/dry I; Herba pireti hot/dry at the end of I. The latter two share cold constitution, old age, winter and cold regions as suitability arguments. Lactuce instead has a different age/season profile. Their harms also differ. Preserve inflected forms, fine degree distinctions and alternatives; do not convert historical medical claims into modern facts.
design.mechanism: A fixed externally named multirelation network generates whole entries through one finite shared lexical realization. Entities retain one identity across entry heads and corrective mentions; relation types distinguish inherent quality, beneficial effect, harmful effect, corrective material, generated product and suitability. Entry-to-entry correction links, field order and repeated suitability arguments must be reconstructed jointly.
design.target_contract: Before target access freeze one existing admitted paragraph frame and a finite literal realization contract, with independent paragraph boundaries and all raw groups accounted for. Unknown entry correspondence and meanings may be solved jointly, but names, relations, source facts and allowed morphological equivalences cannot be rewritten to improve fit. Do not use old workshop POS or thermal glosses as observations. No Voynich paragraph is currently identified as any of these plants.
design.prediction: A putative Apium entry must share the prescribed suitability content with the Herba pireti entry while returning a corrective reference to the distinct Lactuce entry. A Lactuce assignment must also account for its extra feniculum corrective and its differing quality/age/season content. Hold the Apium corrective field out of fitting: surviving assignments must predict its precise mapped Lactuce identity, not merely another noun or another reference.
design.anti_flexibility: Freeze the external named fact table and complete source-selected passage before solving. Enumerate alternative assignments and report which held identities all solutions share. The reciprocal pair alone is insufficient: require the attached third entry and independent attribute relations. A schema fit, shared hot/cold slot, or arbitrary relabeling earns no lexical identification. Missing fields cannot be filled with unobserved German prose.
design.smallest_substantive_result: A two-hour first reconstruction attempt should produce one explicit complete candidate assignment for the three-entry network and a previously withheld named-reference prediction, or show concretely where the fixed source relation bundle cannot be realized. Preparation includes checking the three original source entries against the diplomatic transcription and prospectively specifying the target realization contract. If contract or ambiguity cannot be resolved within budget, retain the named model and its exact unresolved alternatives; do not expand into a control corpus or another unmotivated code-class exclusion.
design.nearest_predecessors: GDT809 tested a common hypothetical dictionary across four paragraphs but did not constrain meanings by this independently named corrective network. GDT735 explicitly found all 24 material-name permutations structurally equivalent; the proposed asymmetric cross-entry facts are intended to break such equivalence. GDT814 compared warm/property, powder, copula and genitive readings, without the fixed remedy-plus-suitability facts. IDEA000115 uses a glossary reference graph alone; this proposal adds signed medical relations and repeated typed arguments from one exact continuous primary passage, rather than enlarging its anonymous star.
design.scope_note: RAW_UNSCREENED, unreviewed, no novelty or readiness verdict. Exact source relationship, compact medical-record interpretation and fixed lexical realization are speculative. No target query, experiment, new Voynich image or confirmed meaning. Voynich f84/f84r remain sealed. Further source acquisition must remain bounded to this passage and its explicitly needed referenced entry.
